newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARIAN O/N RATES CLOSE HIGHER AT 21 PERCENT.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARIAN O/N RATES CLOSE HIGHER AT 21 PERCENT.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed 0.25 percent higher on Friday as the bank's fine-tuned their reserves, traders said.
"This was the last day of the (bank's two-week) reserve period, and there was no more time to play around," said Zoltan Szaloky of ABN-AMRO Bank.
Overnight rates finished at 21 percent compared with Thursday's close of 20.75 percent and traders expected the rates to start Monday trading between 21.00 and 21.50 percent.

Some market participants expected tighter money supply for next week, as expectations of a repo rate cut by the central bank could draw most available funds to the National Bank's reverse repo facility.
The central bank last cut four of its five repo rates on February 17 and the one-week reverse repo, regarded as a benchmark, stands at 21 percent.
